tools.name: now
tools.description: Get the current local time in an IANA timezone, including the UTC offset, zone abbreviation and whether DST is in effect. Use whenever you need to know what time it is 'now' somewhere.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert a specific date/time from one IANA timezone to another (single or batch). Accepts ISO 8601 or natural language ('next Tuesday 3pm'). Returns the converted datetime with UTC offset, zone abbreviation and DST flag.

tools.name: offset
tools.description: Get the exact UTC offset of an IANA timezone at a given instant, DST-aware. Correctly handles fractional offsets such as India +05:30 and Nepal +05:45.

tools.name: timezones
tools.description: List or search valid IANA timezone identifiers by city/region/country, and resolve a city/country name to its timezone(s). Use it to discover the exact identifier to pass to the other tools.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Timezone-aware date arithmetic: add or subtract a duration to a datetime (days are calendar-based and DST-safe; hours and minutes are absolute), or compute the difference between two datetimes that may be in different zones.

tools.name: meeting_slots
tools.description: Find working-hour time slots that overlap across participants in different timezones for a meeting of a given duration, excluding weekends and (when a country is given per participant) that person's public holidays.

tools.name: holiday
tools.description: Check whether a given date is a public holiday in a country (identified by its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), and return the holiday name if so. Backed by an authoritative public-holiday dataset.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "meeting_slots" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find working-hour time slots that overlap across participants in different timezones for a meeting of a given duration, excluding weekends and (when a country is given per participant) that person's public holidays. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
